findings: The explicit one-path mapping requires exact committed retained-ledger bytes; it does not treat the historical ledger as candidate runtime authority.
All other committed Godot source inputs keep exact paths and hashes; an active historical provenance filename in the package is rejected.
Replay requires the exact extracted console engine path, including its immutable hash, and cannot silently execute an external equal-byte engine.
Python and PowerShell validate candidate schema, kind, source/tree/build, full native input mapping, size and runtime digest; MZ is explicitly a header sanity check, not a complete PE parser.
Actual Windows negative fixtures rehash the outer manifest for incorrect/stale candidate ledgers, requiring inner provenance checks to refuse rather than succeeding solely on outer hashes.
Linux acquisition uses the official pinned archive with unchanged size, SHA-256 and engine version plus bounded retry; application qualification still must execute.
delivery_boundary.root_cause: Historical runtime-provenance.json was deliberately packaged under retained-runtime-provenance.reference.json; blanket original-path source replay failed before executing cases.

independent_execution.scope: Focused Python boundary tests; not Windows PowerShell or shipped CMD execution

findings: Recording controls call the diagnostic probe and renderer signal management only. They issue no native control, lease, body edit, or World replacement.
Main physics dispatch, Rapier stepping, native ACK admission and ordinary worker lifecycle are unchanged.
ObjectShard runtime _record_cost retains cumulative call/time accounting independently of optional diagnostic event recording.
Probe methods remain observational and return early when recording is disabled; no ownership or physics decision consumes these measurements.
The actual Structures CheckButton and independent CLI flag share Main.set_object_shard_diagnostics_enabled; enabling Structures alone no longer starts recording.
Stop disconnects deferred post-draw instrumentation and clears a pending upload receipt while preserving the completed recording; restart creates a fresh epoch and clears old samples.
Main._exit_tree disconnects active recording before retirement; disabled recording has already disconnected the callback. Actual runtime and worker cleanup remains unconditional.
